report:
Nail, right hallux, clipping

Received in formalin is a nail clipping labelled right hallux, measuring 1.2 x 0.4 x 0.1 cm. All embedded on edge in 1 block.

(1) Nail clipping, all embedded.

Sections show nail plate. Fungal hyphae are identified within the nail plate on PAS stain. The features are those of onychomycosis.

NAIL, right hallux, clipping - ONYCHOMYCOSIS
